title: Wash the wound with clean water.
translation: Lave la herida con agua limpia.

title: The payment of the bonus is tomorrow.
translation: El pago del bono es mañana.

title: Rotate crops to maintain soil fertility.
translation: Rote los cultivos para mantener la fertilidad del suelo.

title: Boil water before drinking.
translation: Hierva el agua antes de beberla.
